title: Sachliche Anwendung
slide_intent: Restrain expression when fast comprehension matters so information remains the focus.
strategic_value: A quieter treatment can help DB presentations and internal communications feel clear and dependable.
demonstration: The text defines factual use in presentations, office communication and internal information and lists the permitted standard type styles.
practical_value: Choose restrained color and layout and use the named standard styles for these factual contexts.

content_islands.name: Factual-use guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading above the paragraph connecting restraint to quick understanding and orientation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text says the factual treatment supports quick comprehension and orientation.

ingredient.name: Factual communication
ingredient.application: Use restrained typography, layout and color with DB Neo Regular, DB Neo Black and DB Neo Sans as listed.
ingredient.scope: Applies to factual contexts such as presentations, office communication and internal information; expressive advertising has separate guidance.
